trigger: a spell's Grimoire and scroll text
before: burst · one foe · hits on 5–10 (d10) before bonuses, for d6 damage; unless it resists, a survivor is frozen for d4 rounds, then it is just cold and angry
after: burst · one foe · hits on 5–10 (d10) before bonuses, for d6 + your level² damage; unless it resists, a survivor is frozen for d4 rounds, then it is just cold and angry
why: User ruling 2026-09-28 (quick 260928-sq2): "square spell damage just like we do with weapons damage". A spell's damage is its dice + the caster's level², replacing the old level multiplier, so the text names the level² beside the d6.

trigger: a spell's Grimoire and scroll text
before: burst · one foe · hits on 5–8 (d8) before bonuses, for 2d10+4 damage
after: burst · one foe · hits on 5–8 (d8) before bonuses, for 2d10+4 + your level² damage
why: User ruling 2026-09-28: a hit deals its dice + the caster's level², like a weapon strike; the text says so.

trigger: a spell's Grimoire and scroll text
before: multi-target · every foe · hits each on 5–8 (d8) before bonuses, for d10+6 damage apiece
after: multi-target · every foe · hits each on 5–8 (d8) before bonuses, for d10+6 + your level² damage apiece
why: User ruling 2026-09-28 ("each foe gets it"): every foe Lightning hits takes its own d10+6 + the caster's level².

trigger: a spell's Grimoire and scroll text
before: burst · one foe · hits on 5–8 (d8) before bonuses, for 2d20+15 damage
after: burst · one foe · hits on 5–8 (d8) before bonuses, for 2d20+15 + your level² damage
why: User ruling 2026-09-28: a hit deals its dice + the caster's level²; the text says so.

trigger: a spell's Grimoire and scroll text
before: multi-target · every foe and you · 3d10+8, half to you unless warded
after: multi-target · every foe and you · 3d10+8 + your level² damage to each foe; you get half the 3d10+8 unless warded, because the floor does not take sides
why: User ruling 2026-09-28 ("each foe gets it"): every foe takes the one 3d10+8 roll + the caster's level², while the caster's own backlash stays half the roll alone (self-inflicted damage never adds level²). The text states both halves, then borrows the Earthquake line's own joke about the floor's neutrality.

trigger: a spell's Grimoire and scroll text
before: multi-target · d8 bolts · d10+2 each, spread across the foes
after: multi-target · d8 bolts · d10+2 damage each, spread across the foes, + your level² damage once to each foe struck
why: User ruling 2026-09-28 ("each foe gets it"): the first bolt to strike each foe adds the caster's level², once per foe per cast; the later bolts are their dice alone. The text says each bolt's dice and the once-per-foe level².

trigger: a spell's Grimoire and scroll text
before: damage over time · one foe · 2d6+2 a round, d6 rounds
after: damage over time · one foe · 2d6+2 a round, d6 rounds; the first round adds your level² damage
why: User ruling 2026-09-28: a damage spell adds the caster's level² once to each foe it damages; for a damage-over-time spell that is the first tick, so a level-5 Acid is not 25 extra every round.

trigger: a spell's Grimoire and scroll text
before: damage over time · one foe · d6 a round for d4+1 rounds, then frozen solid; past floor 12, frozen for three rounds
after: damage over time · one foe · d6 a round for d4+1 rounds, the first adding your level² damage, then frozen solid
why: User ruling 2026-09-28: like Acid, Ice's first tick adds the caster's level², once per cast; the text says which round gets it. (Phase 90 plan 04, SPELL-12: the floor-12 clause "past floor 12, frozen for three rounds" this row used to keep went with the cap, so the row's after is the line as it prints now; the ledger reads files in name order, so a 90-NN row cannot chain after a q- row.)

trigger: spellHit — the hero's thrown spell lands
before: Hit. Viper takes 6 hp (the roll ×2, for your level).
why: User ruling 2026-09-28: the level multiplier no longer touches spell damage, so "the roll ×2" is retired. The line now reads the event's levelSq and says "(the roll +9, for your level)" from level 2 up; the frozen voice variants carry no levelSq, so the corpus shows only the bare line. The clause is pinned in test/unit/spell-damage-level-sq.test.js.

trigger: spellHit — the hero's thrown spell lands
before: Heal hits Viper (6, the roll ×2 for your level)
why: User ruling 2026-09-28: the rail twin. "the roll ×2" is retired; from level 2 up the line reads "(23, the roll +9 for your level)" from the event's levelSq, which the frozen voice variants do not carry.
